title: Split the loan desk into layers

task.text: `LoanController` formats replies, applies lending rules and stores books, all at once.
Split it into three layers. `Library.open(List<Book>)` and every reply line must stay exactly as they are.

items: Data: `interface BookRepository` with `Book find(String isbn)` (null when absent) and `void save(Book)`, plus an in-memory implementation.
Business: `LoanService(BookRepository)` with `Book lend(String)` and `Book giveBack(String)`. Unknown book: `IllegalArgumentException`; wrong state: `IllegalStateException`.
Presentation: `LoanController(LoanService)` only turns outcomes into `200`, `404` and `409` lines.
Dependencies point down only. `Library.open` does the wiring.

checks.title: Lending and returning behave as before
The controller never touches the data layer
The controller holds only the service
The service knows nothing of presentation
The service works on any repository
The lending rules live in the service

hints.text: Three jobs share one class: talking to the user, deciding what may happen, and keeping books. Each job becomes a layer that may only call the one below it.
`LoanController` holds a `private final LoanService`. `LoanService` holds a `BookRepository` and returns `Book`s or throws. `InMemoryBookRepository` owns the map. `Library.open` builds all three.
